qualifier: replicase translation and host translation control
name: Coronavirus replicase translation and genome replication
rationale: Members cover SARS-CoV replicase translation (frameshifting, capping), maturation, genome replication and host translation modulation, whereas confusables centre on viral RNA editing/APOBEC restriction or PKR and general viral mRNA translation.

name: 5-Lipoxygenase leukotriene and lipoxin synthesis and catabolism
rationale: All members concern 5-lipoxygenase-derived leukotrienes, lipoxins and 5-HETE including their omega-oxidative catabolism and transport, unlike confusables dominated by CYP epoxygenase/HETE, 12/15-LOX or leukotriene receptor signalling.

name: CDX-driven intestinal epithelial differentiation and barrier maintenance
rationale: Most members describe CDX/KLF5-specified differentiated intestinal epithelium and its structure maintenance (leukocyte migration is an outlier), distinguishing it from HNF4-driven intestine-liver-kidney epithelium, Wnt crypt stem programmes and antimicrobial defence.

name: Purine deoxyribonucleoside and deoxyribonucleotide metabolism
rationale: Members concern purine deoxynucleosides and deoxynucleotides including ADA and PNP defects, whereas confusables cover ribonucleoside catabolism, purine salvage or de novo synthesis and pyrimidine deoxynucleotides.

name: tRNA modification and aminoacylation for translational fidelity
rationale: Members cover tRNA base modifications (wobble, wybutosine, t6A, pseudouridine, methylation) and cytosolic/mitochondrial aminoacylation for translational fidelity, unlike confusables centred on tRNA end processing and splicing, selenocysteine or translation termination.

name: Cardiac impulse propagation via depolarization and electrical coupling
rationale: Members cover phase 0 depolarization and gap-junction electrical coupling propagating the impulse through AV node, His-Purkinje and atrial/ventricular myocytes, unlike confusables centred on SA node HCN pacemaking, repolarization phases or conduction system development.

name: Oxidized lipoprotein signaling and macrophage foam cell formation
rationale: Members concern oxidized LDL/lipoprotein signalling, phosphatidylcholine catabolism, cholesterol storage and foam cell differentiation, distinct from confusables on scavenger receptor classes, lipoprotein clearance/remodelling and cholesterol efflux.

qualifier: stalled ribosome rescue with no-go and non-stop decay
name: Stalled ribosome rescue with no-go and non-stop decay
rationale: Members cover rescue and splitting of stalled ribosomes, no-go/non-stop mRNA decay and RQC nascent-peptide degradation, unlike confusables on nonsense-mediated decay, termination, degron pathways or stress granules.

qualifier: endothelial and vascular smooth muscle cells
name: Angiogenesis and vascular endothelial and smooth muscle cell regulation
rationale: Members cover VEGF/Tie/neuropilin signalling, sprouting angiogenesis, shear stress responses, endothelial fate and vascular smooth muscle proliferation/phenotypic switching, whereas confusables concern cardiac muscle growth and heart morphogenesis.

qualifier: severing, depolymerization and capping at the leading edge
name: Actin filament severing and turnover at the leading edge
rationale: Members concern actin severing, depolymerization, barbed-end capping and Arp2/3 restraint supporting lamellipodium and pseudopodium formation, unlike confusables centred on actin polymerization, ruffles and Arp2/3 activation.

name: Neuroendocrine and pancreatic endocrine cell differentiation
rationale: Members concern differentiation of neuroendocrine, adrenal and pancreatic endocrine (NEUROG3+, alpha) cells including transdifferentiation, unlike confusables on definitive endoderm, early pancreatic progenitors, neuroblast proliferation or sympathoadrenal catecholamine neurons.

name: NLRP1 and NLRP3 inflammasome-mediated IL-1 processing
rationale: Members cover NLRP1/NLRP3 inflammasome assembly and regulation, purinergic triggering and IL-1 precursor processing, whereas confusables concern pyroptosis, CASP4/5, AIM2 and IPAF inflammasomes, IL-18 or chemokine production.

core: Tight junction and endothelial barrier regulation
name: Mechanosensitive regulation of tight junction and endothelial barrier
rationale: Members combine tight junction assembly/disassembly and vascular/intestinal barrier permeability with shear stress, PIEZO1 mechanical load, hydrostatic pressure and membrane repair responses, unlike confusables on eNOS trafficking, apical junction adhesion, scramblases or cadherin adhesion and EMT.

name: Glucagon and adiponectin regulation of glucose homeostasis
rationale: Members cover glucagon/PKA signalling, adiponectin, insulin sensitivity, gluconeogenesis and glucose import control, unlike confusables on proximal insulin receptor-AKT-GLUT4 signalling, glycogen/glucokinase, triglyceride lipolysis or ChREBP sugar sensing.

qualifier: negative regulation via Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling
name: Tie2 and VEGFR2 signaling restraining sprouting angiogenesis
rationale: Members are Tie2 and VEGFR2 signalling plus negative regulation of endothelial sprouting, proliferation, chemotaxis and apoptosis, whereas confusables add positive regulation of angiogenesis, VEGF-VEGFR binding/neuropilin or lymphangiogenesis.

name: Rap1 signaling and integrin-to-MAPK adaptor linkage
rationale: Members cover Rap1/Rap signal transduction and assembly of integrin-proximal GRB2:SOS and p130Cas complexes linking to MAPK, unlike confusables on RAF/BRAF oncogenic signalling, platelet GPCR/Rho activation or integrin-mediated cell adhesion.

name: TCR signaling with CD28 costimulation and co-inhibition
rationale: Members centre on TCR proximal signalling (CD3 phosphorylation, ZAP-70, second messengers), CD28 costimulation and CTLA4/BTLA co-inhibition driving T cell activation, unlike confusables on thymic selection, BCR signalling, germinal centre/ICOS help or CD27.

qualifier: nucleic acid sensing driving IRF3/7 interferon induction
name: Nucleic acid sensing driving IRF3/7 type I interferon production
rationale: Members span RIG-I/MDA5, cGAS-STING/TREX1, AIM2 and endosomal TLR3/9 sensing through TRAF3/TRAF6-TBK1 to IRF3/IRF7 and interferon production, whereas confusables concern TLR7/8-IRF5, ISG15 and interferon-stimulated responses or IFN receptor signalling.

name: Neural plate regionalization, folding and neuronal fate determination
rationale: The three members concern neural plate regionalization, neural fold formation and neuron fate determination, unlike confusables on neural plate border/neural crest, hindbrain HOX patterning or spinal cord dorsoventral patterning.

qualifier: thymocyte and bone marrow proliferation and survival
name: Thymocyte and bone marrow cell number homeostasis
rationale: Members regulate proliferation, apoptosis and differentiation of immature thymocytes and bone marrow cells to set tissue cell number, unlike confusables on B cell differentiation, thymic selection, bone marrow development or kidney proliferation.

qualifier: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC
name: miRNA and siRNA biogenesis and RISC-mediated silencing
rationale: Members cover miRNA/siRNA processing and its regulation, RISC assembly, miRNA turnover and silencing by mRNA destabilization or translational inhibition, whereas confusables add deadenylation-dependent decay or target-specific miRNA regulation of individual transcripts.

name: Growth factor-regulated epithelial migration and wound spreading
rationale: Members regulate epithelial and keratinocyte migration and wound-edge spreading together with EGF/VEGFR2 responses, focal adhesion, junction and matrix disassembly, unlike confusables on negative Rho/Rac-integrin adhesion signalling or wound epithelial proliferation and inflammation.

qualifier: nitric oxide-cGMP and renin-angiotensin vascular tone
name: Blood pressure control via nitric oxide-cGMP and renin-angiotensin
rationale: Members cover eNOS/BH4-NO-cGMP vasorelaxation, renin-angiotensin and endothelin control, smooth muscle contraction and renal sodium handling of blood pressure, unlike confusables on vasopressin and glomerular filtration or adrenergic receptor signalling.

qualifier: glycogen, hexose and pentose pathways with inborn errors
name: Glycogen, hexose and pentose metabolism with inborn errors
rationale: Members span glycogen synthesis/breakdown, glycolysis/gluconeogenesis, fructose, galactose and pentose phosphate metabolism with their inherited enzyme deficiencies, unlike confusables on hexose transport and digestion, glucagon signalling or aminosugar and glycan metabolism.

name: B cell activation, proliferation and differentiation
rationale: Members are B cell signature modules and positive regulation of B cell proliferation, differentiation (including B-1) and BCR/CD27 signalling, whereas confusables emphasise memory B signatures, germinal centre and Tfh/ICOS differentiation.
